decision.observation: Tilted up: a pale turquoise pool spreads at left with a stone island holding palms and stepped blocks at upper left, plus a stone ledge at bottom-left. Reticle hollow on the pillar face — no grab engaged.
decision.hypothesis: The pillar is unclimbable. The pool is the route: the stone island/ledge at left is reachable by swimming, and beyond it the piers and rope bridges. Back out of the slot and go to the water.
decision.memory: Pillar slot definitively not climbable; pool + stone island to the left is the way.
